_about: Ten Thousand Wonderful Things (1894), by article title as the book prints it (a title used twice is "TITLE (2)" the second time). Read by hand, then checked again: the curious kept; the dull, the racism, gloating over executions and torture, cruelty to animals, remedies and the like left out. Only what's kept is recorded. See ktdi/tools/wonder_build.py.
